title.en: Local evidence for a host agent
title.zh: 給主代理使用的本地證據

description.en: A local-first CLI and MCP server. The host agent collects, searches, previews, and exports. Muse does not take over, and nothing is published.
description.zh: 本地優先的 CLI 與 MCP 伺服器。主代理負責收集、搜尋、預覽與匯出。Muse 不接管，也不發布。

headline.en: Exact text, before anything leaves the machine.
headline.zh: 離開這台機器前，先看精確文字。

lede.en: MetaMuse CLI keeps permitted social posts, comments, media, and subtitles as sourced evidence. A host agent such as Claude Code or Codex writes the questions and the copy. Muse is a collaborator, not the harness.
lede.zh: MetaMuse CLI 把獲准使用的貼文、留言、影音與字幕收成有來源的證據。Claude Code、Codex 這類主代理負責寫問題與文案。Muse 是協作者，不是主控。

notes.en: Not affiliated with Meta, Facebook, or Muse

alt.en: Terminal preview of a packet: the exact text that would be shared, one url_token redaction, and the SHA-256 digest. The token is shown as [REDACTED].
alt.zh: 終端機上的資料包預覽：將被分享的精確文字、一筆 url_token 遮蔽，以及 SHA-256。權杖顯示為 [REDACTED]。

caption.en: Packet preview from the installed CLI. Synthetic fixture only.
caption.zh: 已安裝 CLI 的資料包預覽。只有合成 fixture。

label.en: MCP tools, same core as the CLI
label.zh: MCP 工具，與 CLI 共用核心
init 之後的 SQLite 綱要

title.en: A pile of posts is not evidence, and a draft is not a publish button.
title.zh: 貼文不是證據。草稿不是發布。

body.en: The host agent needs a local place for permitted posts, comments, media, and subtitles, with the source method kept as it was. Search should cite an exact revision. A share packet should show the exact text, the redaction counts, and a digest before anything leaves. Partial imports must stay partial. MetaMuse does that bookkeeping. It does not write the copy, and it does not publish.
body.zh: 主代理需要一個本地位置，存放獲准的貼文、留言、影音與字幕，並維持原來的來源方式。搜尋要引用精確版本。分享用的資料包在離開機器之前，要出示精確文字、遮蔽次數與 SHA-256。部分匯入必須維持部分。MetaMuse 做這些紀錄。它不寫文案，也不發布。

intro.en: Every step below is a real metamuse command. The host agent decides the question and the wording.
intro.zh: 下面每一步都是真正的 metamuse 指令。問題與用詞由主代理決定。

body.en: Read a local file. Bad rows are rejected one by one. The job ends partial instead of pretending the file was complete.
body.zh: 讀取本地檔。壞列逐列拒絕。工作以部分結束，不把檔案說成完整。

body.en: Find text inside one project. Each hit cites an item revision and names the collection method.
body.zh: 在單一專案裡找文字。每筆命中都引用一個項目版本，並寫出來源方式。

body.en: Build the exact text that would be shared. Count redactions. Record the SHA-256. Do not send it.
body.zh: 組出將被分享的精確文字。計算遮蔽次數。記下 SHA-256。先不送出。

body.en: Save the host's draft with those citations, then export a local bundle. The manifest lists file hashes. Nothing is uploaded.
body.zh: 連同引用一起保存主代理的草稿，再匯出本地套件。清單列出檔案雜湊。沒有上傳。

heading.en: One core, then the file stays put
heading.zh: 核心只有一個。檔案留在原地。

intro.en: CLI and MCP call the same application. The draft never becomes a post.
intro.zh: CLI 與 MCP 呼叫同一個應用。草稿不會變成貼文。

note.zh: 只讀 import_roots 裡的路徑。

note.en: One SQLite workspace for every entry.
note.zh: 每個入口共用一個 SQLite 工作區。

caption.en: The host agent writes the question and the copy. MetaMuse stores evidence and runs bounded actions.
caption.zh: 主代理撰寫問題與文案。MetaMuse 保存證據並執行有界動作。

intro.en: The same application serves the CLI and the MCP server. The Skill in the repository is a neutral guide: if the backend is missing, it must say so and stop.
intro.zh: 同一個應用同時服務 CLI 與 MCP 伺服器。儲存庫裡的 Skill 是中性指引：後端不在時必須說明並停止。

body.en: Text, CSV, JSON, JSONL, subtitles, and local media. A rejected row keeps its error. Seven bad lines do not erase seven good ones, and the job does not become complete.
body.zh: 文字、CSV、JSON、JSONL、字幕與本地影音。被拒的列留著錯誤碼。七列壞資料不會抹掉七列好資料，工作也不會變成完整。

body.en: Exact substring search inside one project. A hit names the revision, the collection method, and the upstream method from the file. file_import is not rewritten as manual.
body.zh: 在單一專案裡做精確子字串搜尋。命中會標出版本、收集方式，以及檔案裡的上游方式。file_import 不會被改寫成 manual。

body.en: packet prepare renders the exact text, the redaction counts, and the digest of that text. The frame on this page shows one url_token redaction. Preparing a packet does not send it.
body.zh: packet prepare 呈現精確文字、遮蔽次數，以及該文字的 SHA-256。本頁畫面有一筆 url_token 遮蔽。準備資料包並不會送出。

body.en: The host writes the question. An explicit fixture backend is available for offline checks and reports fixture_passed. Open and send stay ineffective until a human grant exists. LIVE is not verified.
body.zh: 問題由主代理撰寫。離線檢查可明示選用 fixture 後端，並回報 fixture_passed。在人類授權之前，開啟與送出維持無效。LIVE 尚未驗證。

title.zh: 主代理已經寫好的草稿

body.en: draft save stores the supplied text and the citations the host passes in. It does not call a model, and it does not add a persona, a formula, or a call to action.
body.zh: draft save 保存提供的文字，以及主代理傳入的引用。它不呼叫模型，也不加入人設、公式或行動呼籲。

body.en: bundle, jsonl, markdown, text, and csv stay on disk. A bundle manifest lists each member hash and a redaction notice. The CLI warns that nothing was published or uploaded. There is no publish tool.
body.zh: bundle、jsonl、markdown、text、csv 都留在磁碟。套件清單列出每個成員的雜湊與遮蔽說明。CLI 會警告沒有發布或上傳。沒有發布工具。

title.en: The installed CLI, on a synthetic workspace.
title.zh: 已安裝的 CLI。合成工作區。

intro.en: Each frame is an Alacritty window on a virtual display. The shell prints the command, then runs it. The data is the repository's synthetic corpus. Muse's configured backend is fixture. No account is signed in.
intro.zh: 每一格都是虛擬螢幕上的 Alacritty 視窗。殼層先印出指令，再執行它。資料是儲存庫裡的合成語料。Muse 設定的後端是 fixture。沒有登入任何帳號。

alt.en: Terminal showing metamuse init, a config with network_mode offline and muse backend fixture, and doctor lines with fixture_passed and worker_available=false.
alt.zh: 終端機顯示 metamuse init、network_mode 為 offline 且 muse backend 為 fixture 的設定，以及 doctor 列出的 fixture_passed 與 worker_available=false。

caption.en: init and doctor. network_mode is offline. The config sets backend = fixture, and doctor reports verification fixture_passed. worker_available is false. metamuse_muse_open and metamuse_muse_send stay effective=false until a human grant exists. Fixture observations carry mock=true and research_complete=false; this build does not open that discussion, so those two fields are not in the frame.
caption.zh: init 與 doctor。network_mode 是 offline。設定寫 backend = fixture，doctor 回報 verification fixture_passed。worker_available 為 false。在人類授權之前，metamuse_muse_open 與 metamuse_muse_send 維持 effective=false。fixture 觀察帶有 mock=true 與 research_complete=false；這個版本沒有開啟該討論，所以這兩個欄位不在畫面裡。

alt.en: Terminal creating a project and importing comments_mixed_bad.jsonl with --run. The job state is partial, stop is row_errors, with 7 committed and 7 rejected.
alt.zh: 終端機建立專案，並以 --run 匯入 comments_mixed_bad.jsonl。工作狀態為 partial，停止原因是 row_errors，7 筆寫入、7 筆拒絕。

caption.en: Import with --run. The result is partial: 7 committed, 7 rejected, stop row_errors. worker_available is false when the command returns. Accepted would only mean queued; this frame shows the finished partial job.
caption.zh: 以 --run 匯入。結果是 partial：7 筆寫入、7 筆拒絕，停止原因 row_errors。指令返回時 worker_available 為 false。accepted 只表示已排隊；這個畫面是已結束的部分工作。

alt.en: Terminal output of jobs get listing 14 import lines, each committed or rejected, including E_INPUT_INVALID and E_LIMIT_REACHED.
alt.zh: 終端機的 jobs get 輸出，列出 14 列匯入結果，每列為寫入或拒絕，包含 E_INPUT_INVALID 與 E_LIMIT_REACHED。

caption.en: jobs get shows the invalid-row outcome. Rejected lines keep a code and a field. The coverage remains partial.
caption.zh: jobs get 顯示壞列結果。被拒的列留有錯誤碼與欄位。覆蓋範圍維持 partial。

alt.en: Terminal search for a Traditional Chinese comment. The hit cites an item revision, collection_method file_import, and upstream synthetic_fixture.
alt.zh: 終端機搜尋一則繁體中文留言。命中引用一個項目版本，collection_method 為 file_import，上游為 synthetic_fixture。

caption.en: Search cites one exact revision. The upstream method stays synthetic_fixture, which is the value in the file. The collection method stays file_import.
caption.zh: 搜尋引用一個精確版本。上游方式維持 synthetic_fixture，也就是檔案裡的值。收集方式維持 file_import。

alt.en: Terminal packet preview with the exact share text, redactions of one url_token, coverage bounded, and a SHA-256 digest.
alt.zh: 終端機的資料包預覽，含精確分享文字、一筆 url_token 遮蔽、coverage bounded，以及 SHA-256。

caption.en: The exact text that would be shared, the redaction count, and the digest. The synthetic token is replaced with [REDACTED]. Nothing is sent. backend=fixture is the configured Muse backend; mock=true and research_complete=false belong to fixture observations, which this frame does not open.
caption.zh: 將被分享的精確文字、遮蔽次數與 SHA-256。合成權杖被換成 [REDACTED]。沒有送出。backend=fixture 是設定的 Muse 後端；mock=true 與 research_complete=false 屬於 fixture 觀察，這個畫面沒有開啟觀察。

alt.en: Terminal saving a host-written Traditional Chinese draft that cites one local item revision, with the draft digest.
alt.zh: 終端機保存一份主代理撰寫的繁體中文草稿，引用一筆本地項目版本，並顯示草稿 SHA-256。

caption.en: The host wrote the two lines. draft save stores that text and the citation from search. No model call.
caption.zh: 這兩行是主代理寫的。draft save 保存該文字與搜尋得到的引用。沒有呼叫模型。

alt.en: Terminal bundle export. Warnings say nothing was published or uploaded. The manifest lists text_policy redacted and each file SHA-256.
alt.zh: 終端機的 bundle 匯出。警告寫明沒有發布或上傳。清單列出 text_policy 為 redacted，以及每個檔案的 SHA-256。

caption.en: Local bundle only. The manifest lists member hashes, text_policy redacted, and the redaction notice. The warning says nothing was published or uploaded.
caption.zh: 只有本地套件。清單列出成員雜湊、text_policy redacted，以及遮蔽說明。警告寫明沒有發布或上傳。

alt.en: Terminal running the official MCP Python client. It lists 15 tools and calls read-only metamuse_search, which returns one cited hit.
alt.zh: 終端機執行官方 MCP Python 用戶端。它列出 15 個工具，並呼叫唯讀的 metamuse_search，回傳一筆帶引用的命中。

caption.en: mcp.client.stdio talks to metamuse mcp. The client lists the tools, then calls metamuse_search. Human-only permit commands are not tools.
caption.zh: mcp.client.stdio 連接 metamuse mcp。用戶端先列出工具，再呼叫 metamuse_search。僅限人類的許可指令不是工具。

title.en: One package. The host stays in charge.

intro.en: There is no second orchestrator inside the tool. The Skill tells the host how to call the backend, and it refuses to invent a result when the backend is down.
intro.zh: 工具裡沒有第二個編排器。Skill 告訴主代理如何呼叫後端；後端不在時，它拒絕編造結果。

items.en: Humans grant access. The model cannot.
items.zh: 存取由人類授權。模型不能。

items.en: A share is an exact digest, or it is not sent.
items.zh: 分享要對上精確 SHA-256，否則不送。

items.en: Labels stay source-faithful: backend, mock, research_complete.
Partial is never shown as complete.
items.zh: 部分結果不會顯示成完整。

title.en: What this build will not pretend.
title.zh: 這個版本不會假裝的事。

intro.en: The frames above are the offline slice. Later branches add CI, an attached worker, and approval previews. They are not in these screenshots.
intro.zh: 上面的畫面是離線切片。後續分支才加入 CI、附掛 worker 與核准預覽。那些不在這些截圖裡。

title.en: Fixture is a choice, not a live account
title.zh: fixture 是選擇，不是真實帳號

body.en: Doctor reports fixture_passed for the explicit fixture backend. It does not report live_verified. Opening a discussion needs a human grant, which is not in this build's frames.
body.zh: doctor 對明示的 fixture 後端回報 fixture_passed。它不回報 live_verified。開啟討論需要人類授權，這個版本的畫面沒有那一步。

body.en: A queued job with worker_available false is not running in the background. The import frame uses --run, so the job finishes in the foreground and still reports partial.
body.zh: worker_available 為 false 的排隊工作並沒有在背景執行。匯入畫面使用 --run，所以工作在前景做完，並仍然回報 partial。

body.en: The packet frame shows one url_token replaced with [REDACTED]. The tool also says redaction is not a privacy guarantee. Read the text before you share a bundle.
body.zh: 資料包畫面把一筆 url_token 換成 [REDACTED]。工具也寫明遮蔽不是隱私保證。分享套件之前要自己讀過文字。

body.en: The skill definition tells the host to call a real CLI or MCP server. If that backend is absent, the operation stops. This page does not demonstrate a missing backend; the MCP frame uses the installed server.
body.zh: Skill 定義要求主代理呼叫真正的 CLI 或 MCP 伺服器。後端不在就停止。本頁沒有示範缺少後端；MCP 畫面使用的是已安裝的伺服器。

intro.en: Workspaces belong outside the checkout. These follow the README and omit --json. They do not use a live account.
intro.zh: 工作區要放在檢出目錄之外。下面跟隨 README，並省略 --json。它們不使用真實帳號。

body.en: Creates the workspace database and the offline config.
body.zh: 建立工作區資料庫與離線設定。

body.en: Lists capabilities. Live doctor is not available in this build.
body.zh: 列出能力。這個版本沒有 live doctor。

title.zh: 這個分支上可用的部分。

intro.en: This matches the README on the branch these screenshots were taken from, plus work that is still on other branches. Nothing here is a live-account result.
intro.zh: 這對應截圖當時那個分支的 README，再加上仍在其他分支上的工作。這裡沒有任何真實帳號的結果。

works.en: Offline init and doctor. Network mode stays offline. Live doctor is not available in this build.
works.zh: 離線 init 與 doctor。網路模式維持 offline。這個版本沒有 live doctor。

works.en: Projects, durable jobs, SQLite migrations, content objects, and backup/restore. A new init reports schema 4.
works.zh: 專案、持久工作、SQLite 遷移、內容物件，以及備份與還原。新的 init 回報綱要 4。

works.en: Local import of text, CSV, JSON, JSONL, subtitles, and media. Bad rows stay visible, and the job stays partial.
works.zh: 本地匯入文字、CSV、JSON、JSONL、字幕與影音。壞列仍然看得到，工作維持 partial。

works.en: Project search with citations to exact revisions. A packet preview shows the exact text, redaction counts, and digest.
works.zh: 專案搜尋會引用精確版本。資料包預覽包含精確文字、遮蔽次數與 SHA-256。

works.en: Host-written drafts with local citations. Five local export formats: bundle, jsonl, markdown, text, and csv. Export does not publish or upload.
works.zh: 主代理撰寫的草稿可附上本地引用。五種本地匯出格式：bundle、jsonl、markdown、text、csv。匯出不會發布或上傳。

works.en: MCP stdio with the same 15 tools as the CLI. The explicit fixture Muse backend reports fixture_passed for offline checks.
works.zh: MCP stdio 與 CLI 共用 15 個工具。明示的 fixture Muse 後端在離線檢查時回報 fixture_passed。

limits.en: Pre-alpha. Nothing is released. Version 0.1.0.dev0. Unofficial, and not affiliated with Meta, Facebook, or Muse.
limits.zh: 預覽版。尚未發行。版本 0.1.0.dev0。非官方，與 Meta、Facebook、Muse 無關。

limits.en: Muse LIVE is not verified. No real-account result is shown.
limits.zh: Muse LIVE 尚未驗證。沒有展示任何真實帳號的結果。

limits.en: CI is in progress on another branch.
limits.zh: CI 仍在進行，在另一個分支上。

limits.en: The MCP attached worker is in progress on another branch. Accepted is not running: a queued job with worker_available false is not a background run.
limits.zh: MCP 附掛 worker 仍在進行，在另一個分支上。已接受並非執行中：worker_available 為 false 的排隊工作不是背景執行。

limits.en: Approval previews are in progress on another branch. Human grants are not in these frames.
limits.zh: 核准預覽仍在進行，在另一個分支上。這些畫面沒有人類授權。

limits.en: B12 remote media is in progress. This build rejects remote URL collection.
limits.zh: B12 遠端影音仍在進行。這個版本拒絕遠端 URL 收集。

limits.en: B13 Facebook posts are in progress. There is no live page read.
limits.zh: B13 Facebook 貼文仍在進行。沒有即時頁面讀取。

limits.en: Publishing is not started. The config leaves publishing disabled, and there is no publish tool.
limits.zh: 發布尚未開始。設定維持發布關閉，也沒有發布工具。
